item.title: Winter Riverfront Market draws record crowd at Peoria RiverPlex
item.description: The Winter Riverfront Market in Peoria, Illinois broke a record with 2,500 attendees, featuring 70 vendors and providing a direct connection between local makers and shoppers.

item.title: Lake Camelot Ice Fishing Tournament reels in hundreds for annual winter tradition
item.description: Over 200 people of all ages took part in the 46th annual Lake Camelot Ice Fishing Tournament, enjoying a day of fishing, raffles, food, and prize giveaways.

item.title: Peoria County sheriff's deputy released from hospital after being shot
item.description: Peoria County Sheriff's Deputy Jack Evans was released from the hospital after being shot during a traffic stop, and the alleged shooter, Larry Bell, has been charged with five felony counts, including attempted first-degree murder.

item.title: Emergency demolition ordered after Galesburg house fire
item.description: One person was hospitalized and a house had to be demolished after a house fire early Sunday morning, with the cause of the fire still under investigation.

item.title: Four people were displaced after a South Peoria fire Sunday afternoon
item.description: A house fire in South Peoria caused approximately $70,000 in damage on Sunday afternoon, displacing four people and leaving the house uninhabitable until repairs are made, with the cause of the fire still under investigation.

item.title: 44th annual big game fundraiser at Jimmy’s Bar supports local scholarship
item.description: Jimmy's Bar is hosting its 44th annual fundraiser to support local students, with proceeds from food sales, tips, and staff volunteer time all donated to the scholarship fund and the Kelly Needham Award.
